purpose: Teach: 実戦/石綿/快晴/歳児/ミドル/水上/境内/パース

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、災害時の実戦的救急訓練を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren—we're implementing hands-on disaster emergency training with our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady professional tone. Enunciates key terms without rushing. Confident but not lecturing. Eye contact level.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、石綿暴露患者の中皮腫検診を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes, we're conducting mesothelioma screening for asbestos-exposed patients with our medical team.
lines.style: Slight nod in the voice. Patient, methodical. Warm but clinical. Emphasizes the care in the protocol without softening the gravity of the work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、快晴時の屋外医療巡回を医療チームで実施します
lines.en: Ren—we're running outdoor medical outreach rounds during clear weather with our medical team.
lines.style: Same measured pace as the first line. Professional competence. Light emphasis on 「屋外」—shows breadth of coverage. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、三歳児健診を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Yes, we conduct three-year-old health checkups with our medical team, and we take great care with each one.
lines.style: Warm layer beneath the professionalism. Slight softening on the detail about care. Patient. Not rushing—these are children. Genuine attentiveness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ミドル世代の生活習慣病を、貴院、診られますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital handles lifestyle-disease screening for middle-aged patients, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Genuinely curious but slightly hesitant. Ren's careful here—not performing knowledge, asking to understand. Respectful uptick at the end. Soft but engaged.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、水上事故救急を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we handle water-rescue emergencies with our medical team.
lines.style: Direct, brief. Professional efficiency. Patient tone. No elaboration needed—the work speaks for itself. Steady.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、神社境内の救護所運営を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we manage first-aid station operations at the shrine with our medical team.
lines.style: Same steady professionalism. Slight warmth—this is community care. Composed. No apology for the breadth of their work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療文書のパース処理AIを、貴院、導入されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has adopted AI for medical document processing, hasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Leaning into genuine interest now. More engaged than the previous question. Respectful but less hesitant. Ren finding his footing in the conversation. Warm curiosity.
